scope: Actual supplied game DLL CombatRules.BuildSkill, GetMagicChargePerSecond and AutoBattleMath.Simulate IL execute in .NET 9. No production combat method is rewritten or replaced. The probe parses extracted original MagicConfig XML, invokes real MagicDataInfo property setters and calls real BuildSkill; Unity Resources.Load and Android scene/native render execution are not invoked. This is a controlled resolver balance probe, not a phone battle or animation test.
outcomeSemantics: Results and reverse results both orient the first-described unit as own: winner 1 own victory, 0 own loss, 2 draw. Draws remain separate. Each seed is evaluated with both left/right placements. All scenarios use equal 80 troops, HP100, same listed skill access and MP pool, no city defense.
